# `hub.memberships`

Role and capability membership assigned to a user at an organization or company scope.

Database: `hub`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this membership. |
| `user_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with user_id + scope_type + scope_id | — | users.id | User or agent that receives this membership. |
| `scope_type` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | unique with user_id + scope_type + scope_id | — | — | Membership scope kind: organization or company. |
| `scope_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with user_id + scope_type + scope_id | — | — | Organization or company id selected by scope_type. |
| `role` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | — | — | — | Coarse role: readonly, standard, admin, or owner. |
| `grants` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON array of capability grants that augment the role; null when unspecified. |
| `denies` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON array of capability denies that restrict the role; null when unspecified. |
| `granted_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id that granted this membership. |
| `granted_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this membership was granted. |
| `revoked_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this membership was revoked; null while active. |
